units: Y. Hor. III, 48ᵇ bot. (ref. to Zech. III, 8) אין מופת אלא נ׳ mofeth means prophetic gift.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:17">Gen. R. s. 44</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00322"><he>הַטָּפָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>נתלה נְבוּאָתָן בעצמן</he> their prophecy went by their own names (‘the words of—’).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:13">B. Bath. 12ᵃ</cite> from the day of the destruction of the Temple <he>ניטלה נ׳ וכ׳</he> prophetic inspiration was taken away from the prophets and given to &c. Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ bot.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 702:8">Yalk. Ps. 702</cite> <he>שאלו לנ׳ וכ׳</he> prophecy was asked, what is the sinner’s punishment?—
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:11">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>נתקיימה נְבוּאָתָיךְ</he> thy prophecy has come true.

<cite ref="Megillah 14a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>היכן נבואתיך</he> where is thy prophecy? <cite ref="Megillah 14a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>לדעה לדעת מה יהא בסוף נְבוּאָתָהּ</he> ‘to know’ (<cite ref="Exodus 2:4">Ex. II, 4</cite>) to know what will be the end of her prophecy; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>נְבוּאוֹת</he>.
